Import DLL makes the unqualified constants definitionally the same constants used by the preserved proof pattern. No helper declaration or annotation/spec repair is required.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Unfold or repack store_dll, instantiate its first/last endpoints, preserve the same sentinel fields and dllseg resources, and discharge list-shape pure facts by nil/cons reduction.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: All five obligations move between store_dll and its exact three-resource body; the derivation obligations additionally introduce a wand and cancel/reuse an identical store_dll body.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Use Import DLL and unqualified store_dll/dllseg names. Prove entail_wit_1 by unfolding store_dll and selecting its packaged endpoints. For return_wit_1, substitute the nil equation, reduce head_ptrs/first_value, and repack the unchanged resources. For return_wit_2, rule out nil, unfold the cons dllseg to obtain first_out = getPtr a, reduce head_ptrs/first_value, and repack store_dll. For both derivation witnesses, instantiate the general model with the current model, introduce the separating wand by adjunction, unfold/repack store_dll, and preserve the antecedent empty/nonempty branch and return value.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: Every postcondition resource is already present in P either directly or inside an antecedent store_dll. The only pure computations are first-value of an empty mapped list, first-value of a nonempty mapped list using dllseg's head-pointer equality, and exact propagation of the IsEmpty branch facts through a wand.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: One bounded group is appropriate because all five obligations use the same store_dll/dllseg representation and preserved proof pattern; there are no helper or dependency boundaries, and the group size 5 is below the maximum 12.
